answer: A work-bonded registry resists sybils: each agent identity must lock a refundable bond and build a verifiable work history before it can transact beyond a low horizon. A prism of independent attestations from past clients, completed jobs, and dispute outcomes refracts one claimed identity into checkable evidence, so a fake cannot borrow another record. An attacker must then pay one bond and forge one credible history per fake, while a canyon of lost bonds and public exposure awaits identities caught cheating, making mass fakery unprofitable.
